source_basis: Complete existing Train120 trace review; prior V8/V9 development evidence disclosed. No task IDs or answers in assets.

skill.title: normalized_midpoint
skill.guidance: A midpoint-normalized difference is a ratio: absolute difference / midpoint. Keep decimal scale; multiply by 100 only if explicitly requested. Round once at the end.

skill.title: series_scope
skill.goal: Statistics on exactly the requested observations
skill.guidance: List the requested periods before collecting values; exclude other rows even if nearby. Pair series by period. Sample variance uses n-1; population uses n. Missing values are not zero.

skill.title: annual_log
skill.guidance: Continuous annual growth is ln(end/start)/elapsed intervals. Use matching endpoint categories; count time intervals, not inclusive observations. The result is a decimal rate.

skill.title: compound_growth
skill.guidance: CAGR=(end/start)^(1/elapsed intervals)-1. Keep endpoint units and categories identical. A growth factor is 1+CAGR; multiply a rate by 100 only for percent output.

skill.title: regression_coordinates
skill.goal: Preserve regression coordinates and error direction
skill.guidance: Use the stated predictor: numeric year and zero-based year index have different intercepts. Exclude forecast dates from fitting. Apply the requested actual-minus-forecast or reverse order literally.

skill.title: price_basis
skill.guidance: For constant-price conversion: nominal amount * target CPI / observation CPI. Match each period to the requested monthly or annual-average index; do not invert the ratio or mix index series.

skill.title: table_groups
skill.guidance: Keep blank cells and group headers when parsing tables; removing nonnumeric cells shifts columns. Identify the value by its year and category header, not publication date or numeric position.
